claim: For an unknown discrete-time robotic system x_{t+1}=f(x_t,u_t)+\xi(x_t,u_t)​ operating on a specified compact subset \mathcal{D}\subseteq X\times U, where f is L-Lipschitz on \mathcal{D} and \xi(x_t,u_t) is a compact random variable with lower and upper bounds b_l(x,u) and b_u(x,u), there exists a learning procedure that, given sufficient T transitions collected under an exploration controller whose state–action occupancy induces a known operating distribution \mu supported on \mathcal{D}, outputs a dynamics model \hat{f}​ and a non-vacuous error bound e:\mathcal{D}\to\mathbb{R}_+​ such that with confidence at least 1-\delta (e.g., \delta=0.05) over the training data, a fresh transition (x,u)\sim\mu satisfies \|f(x,u)-\hat f(x,u)\|_2 \le e(x,u)​ with probability at least 0.95, and the bound is non-vacuous in the sense that e(x,u) \le 1.1 max(b_l(x,u), b_u(x,u)).

experiment_recipes.goal: Audit that the benchmark instance satisfies the claim prerequisites before testing any learning guarantee
experiment_recipes.pass_condition: On the pre-specified compact domain D, draw a dense audit grid of state-input pairs and 100000 simulator noise draws. Pass only if: every audited pair lies in D; the known simulator drift f has empirical pairwise slope <= the specified L on the audit grid; and every observed disturbance xi(x,u) lies inside the declared bounds [b_l(x,u), b_u(x,u)]. Any out-of-domain sample, any slope > L, or any disturbance outside the declared bounds refutes applicability of the claim on this test instance.
constraints_not_enforced: Does not test the learned error bound
Does not prove the assumptions for all possible unknown robotic systems
The claim's exploration-controller clause is incomplete and therefore only finite-length input-state exploration is audited
experiment_recipes.rationale: A Lipschitz compact-domain bounded-noise audit is the cheapest prerequisite check: if the domain, Lipschitz, or compact-noise assumptions fail, the claimed finite-sample coverage statement is not applicable.

experiment_recipes.goal: Validate that the exploration data are sufficiently covering D for the learning procedure's stated sufficient-T regime
experiment_recipes.dataset: Estimation/training input-state, state-successor, or trajectory data
experiment_recipes.pass_condition: Partition the specified compact D into the cells used by the learning procedure's covering argument, with maximum cell diameter no larger than the procedure's declared resolution. Collect T transitions under the exploration controller. Pass only if every cell intersecting D contains at least one observed transition and the procedure's own sufficient-T certificate declares the sample sufficient. If any cell is uncovered, or if the certificate fails, the apparatus is rejected before the headline test.
